component_scope.selection: all exact deterministic primitive components emitted by the pinned source builder

interior_reference.semantics: source-owned interior-side reference used only to disambiguate exterior half-space for each convex primitive component; not center of mass, pivot, attachment datum, collision proxy or manufacturing datum

exterior_side_rule.rule: for each source triangle, the exterior side is the triangle-plane half-space away from the owning primitive center; reverse only the normal sign for observation when the stored cross product points toward that center

authority.hard_surface: owns manufactured source exterior/interior side intent and exact primitive interior references
authority.geometry_topology: owns any derived winding repair or structural orientation candidate
authority.technical_art: owns export/import and target-host front-face adaptation
authority.materials_art_qa: own renderer-facing shading/culling and perceptual acceptance

truth_boundary: This contract names which side of each exact manufactured primitive shell is source-intended exterior. It does not adopt Geometry PR #33, rewrite source triangle winding, choose a renderer front-face convention, rewrite normals/tangents/UVs, certify collision/manufacturing physics, transfer downstream acceptance, establish CANON or claim production readiness.
